channel.title: Daily Sudoku Puzzle | Free Sudoku Online, Easy to Expert
channel.description: Play free sudoku online: a new daily puzzle plus unlimited Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert games with pencil notes, mistake check and saved stats.

item.title: Expert Sudoku | Hardest Free Sudoku Puzzles
item.description: Expert sudoku with 56+ empty cells and about 25 givens or fewer. X-Wing and hidden pairs may be needed. Free and unlimited.

item.title: Hard Sudoku | Free Advanced Sudoku Puzzles, Unlimited
item.description: Hard sudoku with 51-55 empty cells. Some need candidate techniques such as naked pairs and pointing. Unlimited and free.

item.title: Medium Sudoku | Free Intermediate Sudoku, Unlimited
item.description: Medium sudoku with 45-50 empty cells. Practice hidden singles and pencil notes with unlimited free puzzles in your browser.

item.title: Easy Sudoku | Free Beginner Sudoku Puzzles, Unlimited
item.description: Easy sudoku with 36-40 empty cells that you can solve with singles only. Unlimited free puzzles for beginners, no sign-up.

item.title: Today's Sudoku | Free Daily Sudoku Puzzle & Streaks
item.description: One new sudoku every day, the same for everyone on the same date. Pick Easy to Expert, keep a daily streak and share your time.
